article.headline: Old Dominion 77, William &amp, Mary 58
article.story: NORFOLK, Va. -- Frank Hassell had 18 points and 12 rebounds as Old Dominion cruised to a 77-58 win over William & Mary on Saturday for the Monarchs' sixth straight win. Old Dominion (24-6, 14-4 Colonial Athletic Association), which swept the season series in the regular-season finale for both teams, outrebounded the Tribe 47-15. The victory made the Monarchs' seniors -- Hassell, Keyon Carter (16 points), Darius James (11 points) and Ben Finney (nine points) -- the winningest class in school history with 94. Old Dominion led 42-32 at halftime, but William & Mary (9-21, 4-14) closed to 47-43 with 15:53 left on a Julian Boatner 3-pointer. The Tribe could get no closer than four and the Monarchs maintained a double-digit lead the last 7:57. Boatner scored 18 points, hitting 6 of 13 3-pointers. William & Mary, which ended its two-game winning streak, was 12 of 36 from long range.
